about.title: About
about.description1: I'm a Shopify Developer and Frontend Engineer with hands-on experience building and customizing high-performance e-commerce storefronts. Currently working at Glyff (Miami), I've delivered 6+ custom Shopify stores for US and Latin American brands.
about.description2: With expertise in Shopify Liquid, React, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks, I transform client requirements into elegant, conversion-optimized online stores. Proficient in Shopify CLI, Sections, Blocks, Metafields, and REST & GraphQL APIs.
about.description3: My proactive approach and attention to detail ensure that every storefront I build not only meets technical requirements but also delivers an exceptional shopping experience that converts visitors into customers.

Built custom Liquid templates, sections, and blocks enabling merchants to manage content autonomously without developer intervention

Optimized Core Web Vitals and store performance, achieving 90+ scores on Google PageSpeed Insights across all projects
Collaborated with designers and clients to deliver pixel-perfect, fully responsive storefronts on time and within scope
